_doc: Frozen gate definitions for the nonuniform-grid work (SPEC_nonuniform.md §20). Created in Stage 0 before any nonuniform simulation. Do not edit without a user decision recorded in SPEC_nonuniform.md; run_nu_regression.py checks the sha256.

decisions.D1: abrupt r=4 reflection judged vs exact discrete R_disc, rel < 1e-3
decisions.D2: r=1.1 taper judged vs R_disc rel < 1e-3 and |R| strictly decreasing base 20->40->80; -60 dB INFO
decisions.D6: Level 2 default grid: y PPW=40 per material, x/z = lambda0/20
decisions.D7: legacy Level 2 judged vs exact discrete Fresnel
decisions.D8: Level 1-1 leakage = SF field minus aux_ref predicted scattered field

0-4.diverge_criterion: non-finite field or max|F| > 1e6 * initial max|F| within nsteps
0-4.stable_criterion: finite for nsteps and W_mod drift < 1e-10

gate1.layout: near PML 20 | SF 20 | j0 | uniform 2 lambda0 | taper down to base/4 | hold 0.5 lambda0 | taper up | uniform 3 lambda0 | far PML

1-0.what: max|F_main - Re[aux_ref e^{i phi}]|/E0 over all y planes

1-1.what: SF: |F_main - aux_ref predicted scattered field|/E0 until incident front reaches far PML (c, 10% margin)

1-3a.method: three-point cos(ky h)=(E_{j+1}+E_{j-1})/(2E_j), all nodes whose 3-point stencil lies in one uniform subregion, excluding j0+-1 and PML

1-3b.h_loc: d_j between the two adjacent dual nodes

1-4a.fit_region: uniform region between j0+2 and first graded node - 1

1-5.interp: distance-weighted H to E primal nodes

1-7.rule: monotone decay from energy peak to < 1e-8 peak; second-half max <= its start value

structures.F1: vacuum | n=2.0, 0.08 lambda0 | n=1.46 substrate into far PML
structures.F5: vacuum | H L H L H (nH=2.0 dH=0.08, nL=1.46 dL=0.12) | n=1.46 substrate

2-4.control: uniform grid, ifmode=s, interface offset 0.3 cell

stageB.B0-2: gate0 0-2..0-5 thresholds on x/z nonuniform grid

grating.default_grid: y as D6; x ridge lambda0/80, groove lambda0/40, r_max 1.1; z lambda0/40

amendments._doc: Test-design corrections found by the Stage 1 preflight (exact discrete predictions) BEFORE any nonuniform FDTD run. No threshold value is changed; they make the measured quantity match the prompt wording. Recorded in SPEC_nonuniform.md change log (D9-D11); pending user review.

D9.reason: prompt: '與連續 θ 的差距在 Δ 加倍細化時以 O(Δ²) 收斂' refines every Δ; with x/z fixed at λ0/20 the transverse error is a floor (predicted order 0.26). With x/z refined: predicted 2.000. The D3 ratio test still runs on the x/z-fixed family as well.
D9.revision: 2026-09-25: family 20/40/80 -> 10/20/40 before any run: the base80_xz member is 26.5M cells x 35k steps (~10 h per run) vs 3.9M x 17.6k for base40_xz; predicted order 2.003 (10/20/40) vs 2.000 (20/40/80), same D3 ratio.

D10.family: L2_{F1,F5}_bis{1,2,4,8}: nested bisection of the PPW=20 grid, dt = dt(bis1)/k, x/z fixed; order vs Richardson R_inf(Δx)
D10.reason: PPW-based grids do not scale the film cell count by exactly 2 (4,7,13,26 cells) and dt follows Δy_min non-proportionally; predicted orders 2.9/2.4 (non-monotone). Bisection family: predicted 2.00-2.01.
D10.revision: 2026-09-25, before any run: k = 1,2,4 (bis8 ~2.5 h/run x 4); order from the 3-level estimate p = log2((R1-R2)/(R2-R4)), R_inf = R4 + (R4-R2)/(2^p-1). Predicted p = 2.006-2.025.

D11.family: L2_F1_ctrl_mh{4.5,9.5,18.5,37.5}: uniform Δ=0.08/mh, interfaces at cell fractions 0.25/0.75, point-sampled eps; error vs the D10 R_inf
D11.reason: 'interface offset 0.3 cell' with PPW-based spacing changes the offset fraction at every level (predicted order < 0). Same-fraction interfaces only translate the film (order 2). Fractions 0.25/0.75: predicted 0.97.
D11.revision: 2026-09-25, before any run: mh = 4.5, 9.5, 18.5 (mh 37.5 ~4.4 h/run); error vs the D10 3-level R_inf; predicted order 0.96-0.97.

D13.change: thin vs full Meep cell compared at resolution 40 (was 80)
D13.reason: measured Meep speed ~190 ns/cell-step single-threaded: full 2x3 cell at resolution 80 ~12 h per run; at 40 ~45 min. Threshold |ΔR| < 1e-6 unchanged. Decided before any Meep run.

D14.change: own-code limit from L2_{F1,F5}_bisxz{1,2}: y bisection AND x/z spacing λ0/(20k), dt ∝ 1/k; 2-level Richardson R_inf = R2 + (R2-R1)/3 (order 2 established by 2-3 and theory)
D14.reason: PPW 20..160 with x/z refined together needs up to ~2e8 cells in 3D; a 3-level combined family needs ~35M cells x 24k steps (~6 h). Predicted |R_inf - R_TMM| <= 6e-6 (threshold vs Meep 1e-4 unchanged). Decided before any run.

D15.change: RCWA order list 41, 81, 161, 321 (was 11, 21, 41, 81); 'last two differ < 1e-5' unchanged; reference = 321 orders. Grating: period Λ = Lx = 2 λ0 along x, ridge (n = 2) on x ∈ [0, 1) λ0 (duty 0.5), groove vacuum, thickness 0.3 λ0, vacuum superstrate, n = 1.46 substrate (SPEC left the substrate open; A4-style assumption)
D15.reason: measured before any grating FDTD run: max efficiency change 41->81 orders 3.7e-5, 81->161 8.4e-6, 161->321 2.7e-6 (conical lamellar, Li rules).

D16.change: test setups: B0-2 on B_ops_xz_graded_pec (x AND z graded, PEC y, source-free); B1/B2 families B_{vac,film}_k{1,2,4}: classical incidence m=1, n=0 (θ=30°) on a thin uniform z cell, x graded (λ0/(28.6k) | λ0/(20k)), y uniform h=0.02/k with the film aligned; s-polarization; 70 periods, DFT 50..70 T0. B3 (grating) keeps the conical A2 angle on B_grating_ppw40.
D16.reason: with the A2 angle (Lz = 3) a three-level x/z refinement needs ~25M cells at k=4 per run and 8 runs per level; the injection-order physics is carried by the x nonuniformity. Decided before any stage-B run.

D17.change: judged reflection runs at base 40/80 use L1_taper_r1.1_base{40,80}_P3: far PML at constant physical thickness 3 λ0 (120 / 240 cells); base 20 unchanged (60 cells = 3 λ0)
D17.reason: failure protocol (results/nu_failures.json): the 60-cell far PML echo (~1e-7) is 1% of the base-80 taper reflection; with 3 λ0 the echo is 1.5e-9 and the base-80 rel. error 1.7e-4. Threshold unchanged.

D18.change: Meep resolutions 100, 200, 400 (interfaces on pixel boundaries) instead of 40, 80, 160, 320
D18.reason: failure protocol: Meep subpixel averaging left first-order errors at non-aligned resolutions (F5 −1e-2 at 160); aligned resolutions converge at order 2 (F5 s: −5.8e-4, −1.4e-4). Thresholds unchanged.
